basic_details.job_title: NIT Arunachal Pradesh Non Teaching Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for Registrar, Medical Officer and More Posts
basic_details.organization_name: National Institute of Technology Arunachal Pradesh
basic_details.short_information: National Institute of Technology Arunachal Pradesh (NIT Arunachal Pradesh) Various Non-Teaching Positions Notification 2026 has been released on 28 July 2026 on the official website www.nitap.ac.in. A total of 4 vacancies have been announced through the NIT Arunachal Pradesh Recruitment 2026.

age_limit.details: Maximum Age Limit: 58 years as on 31-08-2026. Relaxation in age for SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PwD/Departmental candidate/Ex-Serviceman admissible as per Govt. of India norms for posts P3 and P4 only.

qualification.education_qualification: Masters' degree with at least 55% Marks, B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering, MBBS Degree, Master's Degree in any discipline with at least 55% marks
qualification.details: Registrar: Masters' degree with at least 55% Marks or its equivalent grade 'B' in the UGC 7 point scale from a recognized University/Institute with 15 years experience as specified. Executive Engineer (Civil): B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering with first class or equivalent from a recognized University/Institute. Medical Officer (Allopathy): MBBS Degree or equivalent qualification included in any one of the Schedules to the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956 and registered in a State Medical Register or Indian Medical Register. Assistant Registrar: Master's Degree in any discipline with at least 55% marks or equivalent Grade from a recognized University/Institute.

salary_details.details: Registrar: PB 4; Level - 14 Executive Engineer (Civil): PB 3; Level - 10 Medical Officer (Allopathy): PB 3; Level - 10 + NPA Assistant Registrar: PB 3; Level - 10

how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the NIT Arunachal Pradesh Various Posts Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 31-08-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NIT Arunachal Pradesh to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the NIT Arunachal Pradesh Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 31-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NIT Arunachal Pradesh to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Arunachal Pradesh Non-Teaching Positions?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the NIT Arunachal Pradesh Non-Teaching Positions is 31 August 2026. Ensure your application is submitted before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Non-Teaching Positions at NIT Arunachal Pradesh?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies for various Non-Teaching Positions at the National Institute of Technology Arunachal Pradesh as per the latest recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for the Assistant Registrar post?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required for the Assistant Registrar post is a Master's Degree in any discipline with at least 55% marks or an equivalent grade from a recognized University/Institute.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Non-Teaching Positions at NIT Arunachal Pradesh?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all Non-Teaching Positions is 58 years as of 31 August 2026. Age relaxation is applicable for certain categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for General/OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC candidates is Rs. 1000/-. SC/ST and Women candidates are exempted from paying the application fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the NIT Arunachal Pradesh Non-Teaching Positions typically involves a Written Test, followed by an Interview, and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary scale for the Registrar post?
faq.answer: The Registrar post is placed in PB 4, Level - 14 of the 7th CPC pay matrix, offering a competitive salary package.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates from other states apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates from all over India are eligible to apply for the Non-Teaching Positions at NIT Arunachal Pradesh, provided they meet the specified eligibility criteria.

faq.question: Q9. What is the mode of application for these positions?
faq.answer: The application process for the NIT Arunachal Pradesh Non-Teaching Positions is strictly online. Candidates need to apply through the official website within the given dates.

faq.answer: The official notification PDF for the NIT Arunachal Pradesh Non-Teaching Positions recruitment can be downloaded from the 'Important Links' section of this article or from the official website of NIT Arunachal Pradesh.
